title: Zani Vie's latest single, "Her or You," a dilemma with Lovers
htmlContent:
Zani Vie's latest single, "Her or You," tells a heartfelt story of a man caught between two women, a dilemma that is relatable to many. The R&B/Soul artist showcases his vocal prowess in this emotional track that captures the complexities of love and relationships.

At just 22 years old, Zani Vie has already proven himself a rising star in the music industry. With his debut EP "Piece of Me," already under his belt, he has continued to release powerful and moving tracks that resonate with his listeners.

"Her or You" is a testament to Zani Vie's ability to craft songs that tug at the heartstrings. The track is a beautiful blend of soulful melodies, heartfelt lyrics, and powerful vocals that create an emotional masterpiece.

As Zani Vie continues to make waves in the music scene, "Her or You" is a must-listen for anyone who appreciates honest and authentic music that speaks to the heart.
